summary: Data contract validation framework built on pandera. Compiles TypeSpec into pandera DataFrameModel subclasses (BaseDataContract), adds expression-backed validation rules (Rule, RuleRegistry), orchestrates validation (Validator), processes failure cases into structured results. Includes reusable constraint constants and expression combinators.

key_classes.name: BaseDataContract
key_classes.purpose: pandera DataFrameModel subclass accepting any DataFrame backend; validates via Polars

key_classes.name: Validator
key_classes.purpose: Unified orchestrator binding contract + rules + data; compiles ephemeral pandera subclass with expression checks

key_classes.name: RuleRegistry
key_classes.purpose: Composable collection of Rules with context-aware exclusions and + operator merging

key_classes.name: ValidationResultProcessor
key_classes.purpose: Processes pandera failure cases using mountainash relations; enriches with natural keys

key_functions.name: compile_datacontract(spec)
key_functions.purpose: Generates BaseDataContract from TypeSpec mapping UniversalType to pandera types

key_functions.name: guarded(precondition, test)
key_functions.purpose: Returns (~precondition) | test — skips test when precondition is false

lifecycle_notes: Bridges mountainash expressions into pandera validation
ValidationResultProcessor dogfoods the relation API for failure case analysis
risks: Date/Datetime/Time mapped to str in pandera — may cause false positives

evidence.detail: compile_datacontract maps TypeSpec to pandera Field kwargs
Validator with _compile_contract_with_rules creating ephemeral pandera subclasses
RuleRegistry with context-aware exclusions and + composition
